PROVISIONAL_LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL. +Turnabout +Sink into Stupor // Soporific Springs +Unexpected Windfall +Flashback +Mistrise Village / -Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun -Exotic Orchard -Vivi Ornitier -Swan Song -Gemstone Caverns. FLAGGED: cuts the owner-added Samut (split second disables the bargained Beseech free cast and both Azula + Narset's Reversal loops); keep-Samut alternative staged. Lands 26 -> 25 plus the Soporific Springs MDFC; R/U/B land sources 21/21/20 -> 19/20/18 (U 21 counting the Soporific Springs MDFC; baseline counts Gemstone Caverns as rainbow, an upper bound); Spellbook complete combos 9 -> 10 (+11-4276-7089). Azula castable by turn 4 on the play 0.4920 -> 0.4905 with the MDFC played as a land (0.4632 if never played as a land). Game Changers 20 -> 20. MODERATE confidence; no measured playtests.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (four-swap, staged, below the floor). The owner-keep alternative: the primary without +Turnabout/-Samut. Keeps the owner's split-second protection; the Narset's Reversal loop and bargained Beseech free cast stay disabled whenever Samut is on the battlefield.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (four-swap, staged, below the floor). The primary without +Flashback/-Swan Song: keeps the 1-mana counter (stats.cedh.events staple 56.9%) if the owner values stack count over Flashback's combat-turn recursion.
RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (five-swap, staged). Keeps Gemstone Caverns (EDHREC cEDH 78%) and cuts Wooded Foothills (52%) for Mistrise Village instead; fetch count 9 -> 8.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (six-swap, staged). Adds Mox Amber (EDHREC cEDH 53%) over Fellwar Stone on top of the primary. Not primary: Mox Amber is dead before a legendary creature lands (Azula, Ragavan, Birgi, Wan Shi Tong, Geist), and the castability model drops turn-4 Azula on the play 0.4905 -> 0.4638 (MDFC as land).

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (one-swap, staged; the exact Pass C Priority 1 test on the baseline). Spellseeker reaches 30 instants/sorceries with MV <= 2 in the baseline. Not primary: Spellseeker is owner-removed (three-mana tutor body loses to Beseech/Wishclaw/one-mana tutors); Turnabout fills the Samut slot instead.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (one-swap, staged; the exact Pass C Priority 2 test). Bounded ledger: a pre-combat Artist makes 2 Treasures per spell cast while Azula attacks (net 2k - 4 after its own cost); Big Score copied gives 4 cards and 4 Treasures for one discard at instant speed. Not primary: Storm-Kiln is owner-removed (four-mana setup), and it needs k >= 4 combat spells to beat Big Score's mana while drawing nothing.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (one-swap, staged; the Pass C optional separate test). Keeps Big Score and trades the Wan Shi Tong flash value body for the Artist. Not primary: owner-removed card, and Wan Shi Tong is a 43.6% stats.cedh.events staple with flash.
